policy: Twenty distinct primary documents and open-source/API references:18 engineering documents and2 graphics references. Existing v5 engineering sources are reviewed and retained where applicable; targeted connection sources replace unrelated renderer entries. Nepal rules and foreign/product guidance have separate scope. Source revisions and discrepancies are explicit.

sources.title: Seismic Design of Buildings in Nepal, Second Revision
sources.application: Beam links may use a U-link with 135° hooks and a closing crosstie. Hook ends engage peripheral longitudinal bars. Crosstie definition: one 135° end with>=max(6φ,65 mm), other>=90° with>=6φ; choosing 135°/135° avoids 90° alternation. Column hoops have a separate closed-hoop rule; the beam permission is not transferred. Splice placement paragraphs(a,b) explicitly address lap splices; general 50% area wording and mechanical-coupler paragraph(h) do not establish an unrestricted coupler location exemption. V6 middle-half stagger is a conservative coordination choice. Isolated confinement calculation and actual material ductility requirements are retained from v5.
sources.limitations: Annex A RC lateral systems. Section 4.1 earthquake-effect beams factored axial compressive stress<=0.08fck; secondary beams exempt. Section 4.2 earthquake-effect columns stress>0.08fck. Confirm adopted project edition, system, loads/stress classification.
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded and text read; key NBC 105 pages rendered and visually checked
sources.v6_review: Retained where applicable from the inspected v5 evidence, with targeted v6 connection review; numerical project acceptance is not inferred.

sources.title: NS 191:2046 Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement, First Revision 2069
sources.publisher: Nepal Bureau of Standards and Metrology; official Gandaki Infrastructure Development Office host
sources.application: Covers Fe415/415D,500/500D,550/550D,600. D denotes enhanced elongation at the same specified yield/proof grade. Nominal kg/m values for length-based steel quantities. Nominal mass uses 0.00785 kg per mm² of cross-section per metre, equivalent to 7850 kg/m³. Delivered mass tolerances are separately in Table 2. Fe500D: yield/proof>=500 MPa; elongation>=16%; tensile>=1.10 times actual yield/proof and >=565 MPa. This does not by itself guarantee NBC 105 actual ratio>=1.15. BEND TEST mandrel for Fe500/500D:4φ up to and including 22 mm;5φ above 22 mm. This is a material test, not automatically a fabrication minimum. REBEND TEST mandrel for Fe415/415D/500/500D:5φ up to 10 mm;7φ above 10 mm. Not automatically a fabrication requirement.
sources.limitations: Material acceptance standard, not structural sizing or fabrication-detail approval. Confirm NS mark, actual MTC/test properties and adopted revision.
sources.verification: Actual official-host PDF text read in web PDF parser; local download returned503; screenshot timed out. NBSM current catalog lists NS 191:2046, and government landing page explicitly identifies this revision; no later revision was verified.
sources.v6_review: Retained where applicable from the inspected v5 evidence, with targeted v6 connection review; numerical project acceptance is not inferred.

sources.title: Design of Concrete Structures, Module 6 Lesson 15: Bond, Anchorage, Development Length and Splicing, Version 2
sources.application: IS 456:2000 plain tension bond stress for M25=1.4 MPa; deformed bars multiply by 1.6; compression bond multiplier1.25. Ld=φσs/(4τbd). At0.87fy, assumed Fe500/M25 gives48.5491φ; NBC 105 table49φ should govern that selected Nepal table check. Illustrates IS 2502/SP16 standard hook/90° bend using kφ internal radius: k>=2 mild steel,4 cold-worked steel; depicted straight tail>=4φ. These historical categories do not automatically classify modern Fe500D TMT. Anchorage VALUE of bend4φ per45° (max16φ) and U-hook16φ is structural anchorage credit, not arc length or a cutting-length deduction. Bearing inside bend additionally depends on force, internal radius, bar spacing and concrete strength. General IS 456 splice discussion differs from NBC 105 seismic requirements; do not combine its smaller-bar lap basis or nonseismic allowances with NBC 105 larger-bar tension lap rule.
sources.limitations: Primary university teaching notes explaining IS 456:2000; not a Nepal approval or full current amendment set. Prose contains oversimplified percentage descriptions; use explicit equations and verified Nepal table.
sources.verification: Official PDF downloaded and read; figure6.15.3 rendered and visually inspected.

sources.title: An Overview of Revisions in IS 456:2000: Code of Practice for Plain and Reinforced Concrete

sources.application: Cover includes links; durability exposure and required fire period both determine cover. BBS required for reinforcement; cover tolerance+10/−0 mm; no reduction below specified cover. Column longitudinal nominal cover>=40 mm and >=bar diameter; narrowly restricted200 mm/smallbar exception. Footing cover>=50 mm. Durability cover depends on exposure rather than member label; fire may also control.
sources.limitations: Government technical commentary onIS456:2000, not full standard or proof Nepal adopted that edition. It does not reproduce full Table 16/16A, so this review has not independently established beam30 mm as a universal requirement.

sources.title: Standard Specifications for Road and Bridge Works2073, with amendment2075
sources.publisher: Government of Nepal, Ministry of Physical Infrastructure and Transport, Department of Roads
sources.application: Use appropriate mechanical benders and cold slow steady bending; check supplied bending schedules and work to drawing. Source first sentence prints IS 2052, while labelling sentence refers toIS2502; retain this apparent source typo instead of silently rewriting it. Correct drawing dimensions, fixed cover spacers, checked bar shape/size/diameter/count. Splices only where shown on drawing or agreed by engineer; lengths as drawing or directed. No heating and bending of high-yield bars; bars toIS1786/high-tensile bars are not to be bent after placing in works.
sources.limitations: Road/bridge contract workmanship context, not automatically a building design basis. No numeric universal fabrication mandrel obtained.

sources.locator: EC2 8.3 / lecture9-2 (PDF 2); EC2 8.3 / lecture9-3 (PDF 3); EC2 8.4.3 / lecture9-5 (PDF 5)
sources.application: Inside mandrel diameter to avoid bar damage:4φ forφ<=16 mm,7φ forφ>16 mm. Foreign-code comparison only. Separate concrete-bearing minimum φm,min>=Fbt*(1/ab+1/(2φ))/fcd unless all specified exemptions met. Bar-damage mandrel minimum alone is not a complete anchorage/bearing check. Bent-bar required anchorage length measured along bar centreline. Distinguish this geometric length from horizontal projection.
sources.limitations: Eurocode 2/BS 8666 guidance, not a verified adopted Nepal fabrication standard; do not combine its anchorage factors with NBC 105 coefficients.
